title: Is Synthetic Data all We Need? Benchmarking the Robustness of Models Trained with Synthetic Images

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's reliance on contextual cues, such as location, rather than actual object appearance using the FOCUS (Familiar Objects in Common and Uncommon Settings) dataset, and measuring the relative accuracy between partitions with common and uncommon attributes.
Assessing whether models categorize objects based on shape or texture using a cue conflict dataset, which contains images where the texture and shape of an object are in conflict with each other.

Measuring the difference in classification performance using the Mixed-Rand and Mixed-Same partitions of the IN-9L dataset to determine if the model relies on background features instead of the object itself.
